changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23; runs through Dec. 31, 2026 (the term as actually adopted, notwithstanding the ordinance's '365-day' caption -- see legal_basis) or the effective date of new data-center zoning regulations, whichever is earlier. An Aug. 24, 2026 Tulsa Flyer report confirms the moratorium 'went into effect March 25 and expires Dec. 31,' that the Planning Office's first 60-day report has been produced and recommends reclassifying data centers by square footage and widening setbacks from 250 to 1,500 feet, and that final zoning recommendations are due to Council in November 2026, after which Council could adopt them or extend the moratorium. No extension or repeal had occurred as of 2026-09-23.
changes.after: The November 4 planning work-session packet reports the March 25 moratorium effective through December 31, 2026 and schedules a December 2 planning-commission hearing on proposed data-center amendments, with Council consideration afterward. These are proposed regulations, not adopted amendments. The earlier redlined ordinance attachment provides an earlier-ending condition on qualifying regulations but has blank execution fields. Final executed instrument, operative conditions and later action through November 5 remain unresolved.
